name: nyamuru-voice-v0.1-grouped-pilot
selection_metric: dev macro_f1 over all 19 labels with zero division=0; ranking is identical to supported-class macro_f1 because the dev label set is fixed
selection: Best dev epoch per trial, then shared learning rate by mean best-dev macro_f1 over the three seeds. Ties: lower dev loss, earlier epoch, earlier learning-rate order. Save and evaluate every selected seed.
split_limitation: Original groups and reviewed close-contrast families are indivisible. Some labels have no independent dev/test group. Missing support is explicitly reported; this is not a complete 19-class generalization estimate.
adoption: No automatic production adoption or application dispatch.
source_review: Author-reviewed draft, individual user review pending; transfer and Colab training requested. No source text or label edits.
